items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1962-01-31
items.q: Yeah, Alphonse Peek Good and Javala.

ctx.x: And you mentioned some guys gave you a nickname, huh?
Who were they? Yeah, Alphonse Peek Good and Javala. Where was it? That was down at Miller Phillips. I mean at Hunts and Nagels.
And what did they call you? They called me a rat.
